title: antonymy
description: The strong-MLD relation that pairs two predication settlings v, v' when v is strong-MLD-equivalent to the negation-twisted settling of v' - the refinement of synonymy obtained by composing strong-MLD with bilattice negation, which flips truth-only and falsity-only firings while fixing top-firings.

criterion.description: v ~_ant v' iff v ~_sMLD ~(v'): strong-MLD-equivalence to the negation-twisted settling of v'

negation-twist.description: negation flips truth-only <-> falsity-only firing-orbit types while fixing top-firings, so it acts non-trivially on strong-MLD classes (invisible to ordinary MLD synonymy)

symmetric.description: v ~_ant v' implies v' ~_ant v, via the negation involution on the settling category

anti-transitive.description: if v ~_ant v' and v' ~_ant v'' then v ~_sMLD v'': the antonym of an antonym is a strong-MLD synonym, not an antonym

self-antonymous.description: v ~_ant v' iff every NSC firing of v is a top-firing (both-sided, paraconsistent); generic settlings are not self-antonymous (orbit size 1 vs 2 under the negation involution)
